lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr4Ga2Ir2O12 (Sr2GaIrO6) adopts the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 20 atoms per unit cell across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Ir centers with six O neighbors (1.91–2.06 Å) and six-coordinate Ga centers with six O neighbors (2.04–2.18 Å), while Sr centers show ten O neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and edge-sharing between Ir and Ga octahedra, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Ga polyhedra and Sr 10-vertex coordination polyhedra.
